enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket up. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Move arm under pillow. Remain asleep. Breathe rhythmically. Turn to back. Move legs. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, showering, and getting ready for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Adjust shower temperature. Step into shower. Wash body and shampoo hair. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body and hair. Wrap towel. Walk to sink. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast, packing a snack and study materials
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and bread. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out bowl and cereal. Close cupboard. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Eat cereal. Place bread in toaster. Take out toast. Eat toast. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Place snack in backpack. Pick up textbook. Place in backpack. Zip backpack.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to Monash University Clayton campus
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card on reader. Find seat. Sit down. Take out phone. Check messages. Put phone away. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to campus entrance. Walk to building. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Attending business lectures and tutorials at Clayton campus
enriched_activities.desc: Enter lecture hall. Sit down. Take out notebook. Take out pen. Write notes. Listen to lecturer. Raise hand. Ask question. Discuss with classmate. Take out laptop. Open laptop. Type notes. Close laptop. Pack up. Walk to tutorial room. Sit down. Participate in group discussion. Present ideas. Take notes. Pack up. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating lunch on campus and chatting with classmates
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Select food. Pay at counter. Carry tray to table. Sit down. Eat food. Talk to classmate. Laugh. Drink water. Clear tray. Return tray. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Studying in the campus library and working on assignments
enriched_activities.desc: Enter library. Find empty seat. Sit down. Open laptop. Open textbook. Read chapter. Take notes. Type assignment. Highlight text. Write summary. Take break. Walk to restroom. Return to seat. Continue typing. Check phone. Put phone away. Read notes. Write more. Close laptop. Pack up. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to Chadstone for the retail shift
enriched_activities.desc: Leave library. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Sit down. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk to Chadstone. Enter mall. Walk to store. Clock in.

enriched_activities.activity: Working part-time retail shift at Chadstone, serving customers and restocking shelves
enriched_activities.desc: Greet customer. Ask if need help. Scan items. Take payment. Bag items. Say thank you. Restock shelves. Carry boxes. Open boxes. Place items on shelves. Fold clothes. Hang clothes. Assist customer. Answer question. Direct customer to aisle. Clean counter. Organize displays. Check inventory. Clock out.
Clock out. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Sit down. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter house.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and washing up after the shift
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Adjust shower temperature. Step into shower. Wash body. Shampoo hair. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Heating up and eating a late dinner
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out leftovers. Close refrigerator. Open microwave. Place container inside. Close microwave. Press buttons. Wait for timer. Open microwave. Take out container. Close microwave. Pick up fork. Eat dinner. Drink water. Wash dishes. Put dishes away. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Using computer and phone to check emails and review notes under the desk lamp
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Sit at desk. Open laptop. Check emails. Type reply. Open phone. Check messages. Review notes. Highlight key points. Write summary. Close laptop. Turn off desk lamp.

enriched_activities.activity: Turning off the light and settling down to sleep
enriched_activities.desc: Turn off main light. Pull blanket. Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Adjust pillow. Turn to side. Pull blanket up. Breathe slowly.
